title: WSTG identifier to domain map
description: Evidence that the domain set partitions the published standard. `rule` records which step of the ordered procedure decided the entry; rule 0 marks an identifier the procedure deliberately does not resolve to one domain, and those entries must say why.

allOf.description: Rule 0 means the procedure did not resolve to one domain. That is a legitimate outcome, but it must carry its reason -- an unexplained rule 0 is indistinguishable from an identifier nobody looked at.
Any rule other than 0 resolved to exactly one domain, by construction: the procedure stops at the first rule that fires.
